It speaks of a fog of ice crystals, so frost on a scarf is not contradicted. Key and lures unchanged and correct (vapour is invisible; the puff is liquid drops).

be8600b1fe.why: The giveaway naming item is re-keyed to the cause, the grade's fact (heat added melts a solid), and it no longer shares the lava item's choices. Gallium melts at 29.76 C and skin is 33-34 C, so heat flows into it from her hand. Lures are truly wrong: cold does not flow; water does not dissolve gallium; air forms only a thin protective oxide on it (Wikipedia: 'not reactive with air and water' at room temperature) and does not turn it liquid. The revision note's 'does not react with air' slightly overstates (it tarnishes), but no player text claims that, and the context's 'Neither sweat nor air turns it liquid' is true. Voice clean.
